mainline: 面向用户与AI智能体的全生命周期密码与凭据管理系统

state_fields.D_v: current durable authority: grants, requests, origin, phase, budgets
state_fields.epoch: alias of authority_state.version for this paper, not AS root epoch or fence
state_fields.K: all compatible states or reliable over-approximation, never scorer truth
state_fields.O_global: typed responsibility projection over the same durable authority and evidence
state_fields.E_P: trusted evidence, source/profile and execution/acceptance assumptions
state_fields.C: scoped logical assertion records and dependency references
state_fields.Budget_History: reserved/spent/native opportunities, full costs, creation witnesses and discharge tombstones

native_scope.all_descendants: each attempt included or independently fenced/terminated
native_scope.B_independence: verified footprint/frame, not distinct token strings
native_scope.B_window: current validity and explicit finite analysis window

states.A: c bound, direct creation frontier closed
declared p/c material scope proved inactive, no further covered creation

version_relations.name: claim_then_release
version_relations.meaning: Claim reserves; Release spends and records attempt before external call

version_relations.name: old_inflight
version_relations.meaning: old native execution may continue, all original responsibility retained

version_relations.name: stale_B_check
version_relations.meaning: new release rejected despite old historically valid certificate

version_relations.name: replay_revoke
version_relations.meaning: first commit_version retained, outer current version may advance

events.W_gate: LocalSafetyGuard or independently valid planning contract, plus final source guards

updates: keep residual risk if not saturated

certificate_kinds.proves: C_local for exact old grant and covered entrypoints
certificate_kinds.historical_mode: trusted commit record and source coverage
certificate_kinds.current_mode: same grant still inactive and coverage current

certificate_kinds.proves: specific request eligible at checked state, or specific one release committed
certificate_kinds.inflight_after_later_revoke: retains original source semantics and responsibility

certificate_kinds.proves: only declared creation/material/descendant/acceptance scope with source proof

combination_conditions: common compatible state or valid migration/frame
proof_status: conditional paper invariant proof, standard composition, no runtime or machine validation
